answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 9524 Country: India Title: Question: ASSALAMUALAIKUM WA RAHMETULLAH I AM NOT ABLE TO PRAY FAJAR SALLAH & I FEEL LAZY TO WAKE EARLY IN MORNING PLEASE GIVE ME A AMAL SO I CAN WAKE UP EARLY IN MORNING Answer ID: 9524 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2228/2027=D/1429) You should make wudhu when you go to bed and have intention to get up in the morning. Recite the last verse of Surah Al-Kahaf and sleep having a firm intention to wake up in the morning; you shall wake up timely, in-sha-Allah. When you get up from your sleep, you should not get slackened and do not let any thought to come. Also, recite the kailmah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
